content: It's almost vacation time. Have you found a summer job yet?
I suppose I can work at the boys camp, but camp jobs don't pay much. So I won't consider it.
I think I can get a job at the Seaview Hotel. A friend of mine was a waiter there. He got a lot of tips. Tips are a great way to make extra money, you know.
What I want is a job outside. This summer, I think I might work for a road building company or something like that. I hear physical work pays pretty well.
